description_en: Stops a trail and stops the event delivery of ActionTrail management events to OSS or SLS
description_zh: 停止跟踪，停止将操作审计事件投递到 OSS 或 SLS
name: StopLogging

parameters.help_en:
The name of the trail to disable.

The name must be 6 to 36 characters in length and must start with a lowercase letter. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Trail names must be unique within the same account
parameters.help_zh:
要禁用的跟踪名称。  
长度为6～36个字符，必须以小写英文字母开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。

同一个账号内跟踪名称不可重复
parameters.name: name
